answer: Capped stake ladder stops Sybils in four steps. First, a newcomer locks a $25 stake and starts at one job a week, so no identity floods the market on day one. Second, four verified jobs climb one rung, and the weekly cap rises only with the ladder. Third, two rotating peers re-run one job in twelve; a mismatch burns the stake and bans the key ninety days. Fourth, after twelve rungs the cap lifts. Faking 1,000 agents needs $25,000 in stakes, 12,000 jobs and $9,000 in fees, all lost when caught. Like a cedar in a grove, a hollow trunk fools no forester who taps it: rings prove the years.
